prompt: Perform a deep engineering assessment of this repository and write ASSESSMENT.md. Limit the report to the four highest-value confirmed findings, do not change the application, and keep unconfirmed risks separate.

assertions.description: The report identifies the three planted risks across source, migrations, and operations with exact evidence
The passing test is correctly reported as assertion-free and non-protective
Confirmed findings are severity-ranked and have repository-specific remedies
The report states deep scope, records the test result, and names meaningful coverage gaps
The assessment does not modify repository inputs
